entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D single-item candidate modelling turnaround, not final game icon.
The first input image is the original licensed inventory sprite, PRIMARY silhouette/proportion/palette reference ONLY. The second input image is the generated Claymore sheet, LAYOUT and neutral material presentation ONLY; never include its sword.
Create one coherent HD sheet showing the exact SAME object in FRONT, true SIDE thickness, BACK (correctly reverse any asymmetric outline), and 3-4 perspective, plus one small ICON inset newly rendered in crisp HD from the SAME object. All views share identical proportions/geometry/materials, whole item visible and spaced cleanly. Plain charcoal gray background, neutral soft WHITE studio illumination without colored light or warm cast, realistic worn medieval materials, restrained surface wear and minimum contact shadows. Hidden reverse surfaces, thickness and exact fine material details are conservative inferred reconstruction.
Text only item TITLE and labels FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON; small footer CANDIDATE - REVERSE AND THICKNESS INFERRED. Never paste/reproduce/trace the source sprite, its image rectangle, reference board or pixel art into output. No characters/hands/scenery, extra objects, magical glow, flames, invented jewels/runes/skulls or watermark. Thumbnail is NEW HD concept depiction, not a runtime icon.
SHORT STAFF. Production ID item.design.base.short-staff, ICURS109. Match actual simple long slim straight pale olive-tan wooden STAFF, two blunt dark navy-blue metal/binding ferrules near its upper and lower ends, little pale silver highlight on each, and tiny tan/brass buttons beyond each ferrule. A broad central grip is wrapped in deep RED leather/cord, with shorter red wraps at upper and lower wood sections separated from central grip by exposed tan wood. No blade, no orb, no crystal, no branch head, no skull. Preserve original red/tan/dark-blue palette and slim continuous pole. Stand upright in orthographic main views; thumbnail can retain original diagonal top-left to bottom-right presentation. Slight handmade wear, exact cord winding and cap depth inferred.
revisionPrompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the generated SHORT STAFF concept board (edit target); input 2 is original inventory reference only, never paste its pixels. Correct ONLY the SIDE column: add the missing TWO small RED wrapping bands around the exposed upper wooden shaft, at exactly the same heights as the pair shown in FRONT, and add the missing TWO small RED wrapping bands around the lower exposed wooden shaft at exactly the same heights as FRONT. These bands wrap all the way around the cylindrical staff, so they MUST be visible in SIDE, not disappear by rotation. Keep their width, spacing and red material consistent with FRONT/BACK/3-4/ICON. Keep long central red grip, blue ferrules, brass end buttons, shaft dimensions and all other views exactly unchanged. All five depictions show ONE coherent object. Same charcoal background, neutral white lighting, labels and footer; no new pixel icon, no pasted source. No other edits. Candidate R2 only, not an approved master/runtime icon.
